## ==========================================================
## 1. Librerías
## ==========================================================

library(rjson)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(zoo)
library(mFilter)   # para hpfilter

library(ggplot2)

## ==========================================================
## 2. Funciones helper
## ==========================================================
bde_get_series <- function(user, pass, series_id,
                           first_date = "1996-01-01",
                           last_date  = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")) {

  base_url <- "https://si3.bcentral.cl/SieteRestWS/SieteRestWS.ashx"

  res <- httr::GET(
    base_url,
    query = list(
      user       = user,
      pass       = pass,
      timeseries = series_id,
      firstdate  = first_date,
      lastdate   = last_date,
      `function` = "GetSeries"
    ),
    httr::timeout(60)
  )

  httr::stop_for_status(res)

  txt <- httr::content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")

  txt <- iconv(
    txt,
    from = "UTF-8",
    to = "UTF-8",
    sub = ""
  )

  if (is.na(txt) || !nzchar(txt)) {
    raw <- httr::content(res, as = "raw")
    txt <- rawToChar(raw)
    txt <- iconv(
      txt,
      from = "latin1",
      to = "UTF-8",
      sub = ""
    )
  }

  json_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(txt, simplifyVector = FALSE)

  if (is.null(json_data$Series$Obs) || length(json_data$Series$Obs) == 0) {
    return(data.frame())
  }

  obs_list <- json_data$Series$Obs

  df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(obs_list, function(x) {
      data.frame(
        indexDateString = enc2utf8(as.character(x$indexDateString)),
        value           = enc2utf8(as.character(x$value)),
        statusCode      = enc2utf8(as.character(x$statusCode)),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    })
  )

  names(df) <- c("date_str", "value", "status")

  df$date <- as.Date(df$date_str, format = "%d-%m-%Y")

  if (all(is.na(df$date))) {
    df$date <- as.Date(df$date_str)
  }

  df$value <- gsub(",", ".", df$value, fixed = TRUE)

  suppressWarnings({
    df$value_num <- as.numeric(df$value)
  })

  df
}

## ---- 2.2 FRED: descarga genérica ----
fred_get_series <- function(api_key, series_id,
                            start_date = "1996-01-01",
                            end_date   = format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")) {
  url <- "https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations"
  
  res <- GET(url, query = list(
    series_id         = series_id,
    api_key           = api_key,
    file_type         = "json",
    observation_start = start_date,
    observation_end   = end_date
  ))
  
  stop_for_status(res)
  
  json_data <- fromJSON(content(res, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8"))
  df <- json_data$observations
  
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    warning(paste("Sin observaciones para la serie FRED:", series_id))
    return(data.frame())
  }
  
  df$date <- as.Date(df$date)
  suppressWarnings({
    df$value_num <- as.numeric(df$value)
  })
  
  df
}

## ---- 2.3 Conversión a frecuencia trimestral (promedio) ----
to_quarterly <- function(df, varname,
                         date_col = "date",
                         value_col = "value_num",
                         fun = mean) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(data.frame())
  
  df %>%
    select(all_of(c(date_col, value_col))) %>%
    rename(date = !!date_col, value = !!value_col) %>%
    mutate(qdate = as.yearqtr(date)) %>%
    group_by(qdate) %>%
    summarise(
      !!varname := fun(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  mutate(tpm = case_when(
    qdate <= as.yearqtr("2001Q2", format = "%YQ%q") ~ tpm + 3,
    qdate == as.yearqtr("2001Q3", format = "%YQ%q") ~ 6.5,
    TRUE ~ tpm  # El resto queda igual
  ))

## ==========================================================
## 8. Transformaciones logarítmicas (ln(x)*100)
## ==========================================================

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  mutate(
    lpib_no_minero = if_else(!is.na(pib_no_minero) & pib_no_minero > 0,
                             log(pib_no_minero) * 100, NA_real_),
    lipc = if_else(!is.na(ipc) & ipc > 0,
                   log(ipc) * 100, NA_real_),
    lipc_sin_vol = if_else(!is.na(ipc_sin_vol) & ipc_sin_vol > 0,
                           log(ipc_sin_vol) * 100, NA_real_),
    ltcr = if_else(!is.na(tcr) & tcr > 0,
                   log(tcr) * 100, NA_real_),
    lcpi_us = if_else(!is.na(cpi_us) & cpi_us > 0,
                      log(cpi_us) * 100, NA_real_),
    ltcr = if_else(!is.na(tcr) & tcr > 0,
                      log(tcr) * 100, NA_real_)
    
  )
## ==========================================================
## Helper: HP one-sided (endpoint recursion)
## ==========================================================
hp_onesided <- function(x, lambda = 1600, min_obs = 20) {
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))

  valid <- which(!is.na(x))
  if (length(valid) < min_obs) return(out)

  x_valid <- x[valid]

  for (i in seq_along(x_valid)) {
    if (i >= min_obs) {
      hp_i <- mFilter::hpfilter(x_valid[1:i], freq = lambda)
      out[valid[i]] <- as.numeric(tail(hp_i$trend, 1))
    }
  }

  out
}

## ==========================================================
## 9.1. PIB potencial histórico con HP one-sided (hasta 2020Q4)
## ==========================================================

idx_hist <- which(db_trimestral$year < 2021 & !is.na(db_trimestral$lpib_no_minero))

db_trimestral$pib_pot <- NA_real_

lpib_hist <- db_trimestral$lpib_no_minero[idx_hist]
pib_pot_hist_onesided <- hp_onesided(lpib_hist, lambda = 1600, min_obs = 20)

db_trimestral$pib_pot[idx_hist] <- pib_pot_hist_onesided


## 9.2. Trayectoria exógena de GAP 2021Q1–2026Q1

gap_values <- c(-0.477,

# Nos quedamos solo con la trayectoria hasta 2025Q3 (primeros 19 trimestres)
gap_values_use <- gap_values[1:20]

# Índices de los trimestres desde 2021Q1 en adelante
idx_2021_on <- which(db_trimestral$year >= 2021)
idx_2021_on <- idx_2021_on[order(db_trimestral$qdate[idx_2021_on])]

# Match 2021Q1–2025Q3 con los primeros 19 índices
idx_gap <- idx_2021_on[1:length(gap_values_use)]

# Columna con la brecha exógena
db_trimestral$gap_exog <- NA_real_
db_trimestral$gap_exog[idx_gap] <- gap_values_use

## 9.3. Definir PIB potencial (log*100) para 2021Q1–2025Q3
## gap_t = lpib_no_minero_t - pib_pot_t  =>  pib_pot_t = lpib_no_minero_t - gap_t

db_trimestral$pib_pot[idx_gap] <-
  db_trimestral$lpib_no_minero[idx_gap] - db_trimestral$gap_exog[idx_gap]

## 9.4. Calcular la brecha de producto implícita para todo el período
## (para 2021Q1–2025Q3 coincide exactamente con gap_exog;
##  para el resto proviene del HP filter)

db_trimestral$gap_pib <-
  db_trimestral$lpib_no_minero - db_trimestral$pib_pot

## Usar PIB no minero en nivel (no log) para HP one-sided
idx_hist2 <- which(db_trimestral$year < 2021 & !is.na(db_trimestral$pib_no_minero))

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  mutate(
    pib_pot_nivel = NA_real_
  )

pib_hist_nivel <- db_trimestral$pib_no_minero[idx_hist2]
pib_pot_nivel_onesided <- hp_onesided(pib_hist_nivel, lambda = 1600, min_obs = 20)

db_trimestral$pib_pot_nivel[idx_hist2] <- pib_pot_nivel_onesided

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  mutate(
    Gap_PIB_nivel = if_else(
      !is.na(pib_no_minero) & !is.na(pib_pot_nivel) & pib_pot_nivel > 0,
      (pib_no_minero / pib_pot_nivel - 1) * 100,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

  "2018Q4" = -1.049162387263532,
  "2019Q1" = -1.348643289415455,
  "2019Q2" = -1.222656665280987,
  "2019Q3" = -1.272354526909674,
  "2019Q4" = -5.614611927982665,
  "2020Q1" = -2.961179307194357,
  "2020Q2" = -15.644322721802661,
  "2020Q3" = -11.209283594069989,
  "2020Q4" = -3.743220983959708
)

gap_ipom_df <- tibble::tibble(
  q_key = names(gap_ipom),
  gap_ipom_aux = as.numeric(gap_ipom)
)

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 9B.2 HP fallback para 2000Q1–2004Q4
##     Esto no depende de que exista gap_pib antes.
## ----------------------------------------------------------

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  select(
    -any_of(c(
      "gap_ipom_aux",
      "pib_pot_hp_fallback",
      "gap_hp_fallback",
      "gap_pib_bcch",
      "pib_pot_bcch",
      "pib_pot_bcch_nivel",
      "gap_pib_ipom",
      "pib_pot_ipom"
    ))
  )

db_trimestral$pib_pot_hp_fallback <- NA_real_
db_trimestral$gap_hp_fallback     <- NA_real_

idx_hp <- which(
  db_trimestral$qdate <= as.yearqtr("2020 Q4") &
    !is.na(db_trimestral$lpib_no_minero)
)

if (length(idx_hp) >= 8) {
  hp_aux <- mFilter::hpfilter(
    db_trimestral$lpib_no_minero[idx_hp],
    freq = 1600
  )
  
  db_trimestral$pib_pot_hp_fallback[idx_hp] <- as.numeric(hp_aux$trend)
  db_trimestral$gap_hp_fallback[idx_hp] <-
    db_trimestral$lpib_no_minero[idx_hp] -
    db_trimestral$pib_pot_hp_fallback[idx_hp]
}

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 9B.3 Pegar brecha IPoM a la base
## ----------------------------------------------------------

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  left_join(gap_ipom_df, by = "q_key")

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 9B.4 Imponer brecha final manteniendo nombre gap_pib_bcch
## ----------------------------------------------------------

if (!"gap_exog" %in% names(db_trimestral)) {
  db_trimestral$gap_exog <- NA_real_
}

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  mutate(
    gap_pib_bcch = case_when(
      
      ## 2000Q1–2004Q4: HP fallback porque gap_ipom es NA
      qdate >= as.yearqtr("2000 Q1") &
        qdate <= as.yearqtr("2004 Q4") &
        is.na(gap_ipom_aux) ~ gap_hp_fallback,
      
      ## 2005Q1–2020Q4: brecha IPoM histórica directa
      qdate >= as.yearqtr("2005 Q1") &
        qdate <= as.yearqtr("2020 Q4") &
        !is.na(gap_ipom_aux) ~ gap_ipom_aux,
      
      ## 2021Q1 en adelante: brecha oficial IPoM que tú pusiste en gap_values
      qdate >= as.yearqtr("2021 Q1") &
        !is.na(gap_exog) ~ gap_exog,
      
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 9B.5 Construir potencial implícito manteniendo nombre pib_pot_bcch
##
##     Definición usada en el resto del script:
##     gap_pib_bcch = lpib_no_minero - pib_pot_bcch
##
##     Por tanto:
##     pib_pot_bcch = lpib_no_minero - gap_pib_bcch
## ----------------------------------------------------------

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  mutate(
    pib_pot_bcch = if_else(
      !is.na(lpib_no_minero) & !is.na(gap_pib_bcch),
      lpib_no_minero - gap_pib_bcch,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    pib_pot_bcch_nivel = if_else(
      !is.na(pib_pot_bcch),
      exp(pib_pot_bcch / 100),
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    ## Alias para claridad, pero NO reemplazan los nombres antiguos.
    gap_pib_ipom = gap_pib_bcch,
    pib_pot_ipom = pib_pot_bcch
  )

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 9B.6 Chequeo rápido
## ----------------------------------------------------------

check_gap_ipom <- db_trimestral %>%
  filter(
    qdate >= as.yearqtr("2000 Q1"),
    qdate <= as.yearqtr("2020 Q4")
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_na_gap_pib_bcch = sum(is.na(gap_pib_bcch)),
    min_q = min(qdate),
    max_q = max(qdate)
  )

print(check_gap_ipom)

if (check_gap_ipom$n_na_gap_pib_bcch > 0) {
  warning("Hay NA en gap_pib_bcch entre 2000Q1 y 2020Q4. Revisa lpib_no_minero/pib_no_minero.")
}

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 9B.7 Gráfico de brecha
## ----------------------------------------------------------

df_gap_plot <- db_trimestral %>%
  filter(
    qdate >= as.yearqtr("2000 Q1") 
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    fuente_gap = case_when(
      qdate <= as.yearqtr("2004 Q4") ~ "HP fallback",
      qdate >= as.yearqtr("2005 Q1") ~ "IPoM impuesto",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

ggplot(df_gap_plot, aes(x = date_q, y = gap_pib_bcch)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Brecha de producto no minero",
    subtitle = "2000Q1–2004Q4: HP fallback; 2005Q1–2020Q4: IPoM impuesto",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Porcentaje"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )

## ==========================================================
## 10. Precios reales de cobre y petróleo (deflactados por CPI US)
##     y transformación ln(x) * 100
## ==========================================================
## 10.1. Tomar CPI US de referencia en 2020Q1
ref_2020q1 <- with(db_trimestral, which(year == 2020 & quarter == 1)[1])

cpi_us_ref <- db_trimestral$cpi_us[ref_2020q1]

## 10.2. Deflactar precios nominales a dólares de 2020Q1
db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  mutate(
    # Precios reales en dólares de 2020Q1:
    # p_real_t = p_nom_t * (CPI_2020Q1 / CPI_t)
    cobre_real = if_else(
      !is.na(cobre) & !is.na(cpi_us) & cobre > 0 & cpi_us > 0,
      cobre * cpi_us_ref / cpi_us,
      NA_real_
    ),
    petroleo_real = if_else(
      !is.na(petroleo) & !is.na(cpi_us) & petroleo > 0 & cpi_us > 0,
      petroleo * cpi_us_ref / cpi_us,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # Logaritmo natural de los precios reales * 100
    lcobre_real = if_else(
      !is.na(cobre_real) & cobre_real > 0,
      log(cobre_real) * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),
    lpetroleo_real = if_else(
      !is.na(petroleo_real) & petroleo_real > 0,
      log(petroleo_real) * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),
    energiav12 = if_else(
      !is.na(energia),
      (log(energia) - lag(log(energia), 4)) * 100 ,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

## 11.4 Leer ponderadores anuales desde Excel

file_path_pond <- file.path("..", "..", "data", "raw", "Ponderadores.xls")

Ponderadores <- read_excel(
  file_path_pond,
  sheet     = "NuevosPonderadores",
  skip      = 1,
  col_names = TRUE,
  range     = cell_limits(c(1, 1), c(NA, 6))
)

Ponderadores <- Ponderadores %>%
  rename(year = fecha) %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(year)) %>%
  rename(
    Brasil_w = Brasil,
    China_w  = China,
    EEUU_w   = `Estados Unidos`,
    Japon_w  = Japón,
    Euro_w   = `Zona Euro`
  )

## 11.5 Asignar ponderadores a cada trimestre y calcular crecimiento ponderado

crec_socios_q <- crec_socios_q %>%
  left_join(Ponderadores, by = "year") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    crec_socios = sum(
      Brasil_g * Brasil_w,
      China_g  * China_w,
      EEUU_g   * EEUU_w,
      Japon_g  * Japon_w,
      Euro_g   * Euro_w,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) /
    sum(
      c(Brasil_w, China_w, EEUU_w, Japon_w, Euro_w),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(qdate, crec_socios)

## 11.6 Incorporar a la base de trabajo db_trimestral

## 11.6 Incorporar a la base de trabajo db_trimestral
##      Versión robusta: evita crec_socios.x / crec_socios.y
db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  select(-any_of(c("crec_socios", "crec_socios.x", "crec_socios.y"))) %>%
  left_join(crec_socios_q, by = "qdate")

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 13B.4 Helpers
## ----------------------------------------------------------
fill_log_from_yoy <- function(log_var, yoy_perc, qdate_vec) {
  out <- log_var
  for (i in seq_along(out)) {
    if (is.na(out[i]) && !is.na(yoy_perc[i])) {
      prev_qdate <- qdate_vec[i] - 1
      j <- which(qdate_vec == prev_qdate)
      if (length(j) == 1 && !is.na(out[j])) {
        d4_log <- 100 * log(1 + yoy_perc[i] / 100)
        out[i] <- out[j] + d4_log
      }
    }
  }
  out
}

make_matlab_vec <- function(db, var, name, q_from, q_to, digits = 12) {
  sub <- db %>%
    filter(qdate >= q_from, qdate <= q_to) %>%
    arrange(qdate)

  vals <- sub[[var]]
  if (any(is.na(vals))) {
    warning(sprintf("La variable %s tiene NA en el rango de proyección.", var))
  }

  txt <- paste0(
    name, "(startfcast:startfcast+", length(vals) - 1, ") = [",
    paste0(round(vals, digits), collapse = ", "),
    "];"
  )
  cat(txt, "\n")
}

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 13B.5 Base histórica compacta
## ----------------------------------------------------------
db_hist <- db_trimestral %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  select(
    qdate, year, quarter,
    pib_no_minero, lpib_no_minero,
    pib_pot_bcch, gap_pib_bcch,
    ipc, lipc,
    ipc_sin_vol, lipc_sin_vol,
    cpi_us,
    cobre, lcobre_real,
    petroleo, lpetroleo_real, alimentos, energiav12,
    tcr, ltcr,
    tpm, tasa_neutral, tasa_coloc,
    crec_socios, ffr, us10y, vix,
    eee_ipc12,
    eee_ipcsv12
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sample = "hist",
    w      = w_hist
  )

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 13B.6 Unir historia + pseudo-muestra
## ----------------------------------------------------------
db_model <- db_hist %>%
  full_join(proy_inputs, by = "qdate") %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  mutate(
    year    = year(as.Date(qdate)),
    quarter = quarter(as.Date(qdate)),
    sample  = if_else(qdate < q_start_fcast, "hist", "ipom"),
    w       = if_else(sample == "hist", w_hist, w_ipom)
  )

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 13B.7 Completar series futuras observables/exógenas
## ----------------------------------------------------------
db_model <- db_model %>%
  mutate(
        year         = if_else(sample == "ipom", year_fcast, year),

    ltcr         = if_else(sample == "ipom", ltcr_fcast, ltcr),
    tcr          = if_else(sample == "ipom", exp(ltcr / 100), tcr),

    cobre        = if_else(sample == "ipom", cobre_nom_fcast, cobre),
    lcobre_real  = if_else(sample == "ipom", lcobre_real_fcast, lcobre_real),

    petroleo        = if_else(sample == "ipom", petroleo_nom_fcast, petroleo),
    lpetroleo_real  = if_else(sample == "ipom", lpetroleo_real_fcast, lpetroleo_real),

    alimentos = if_else(sample == "ipom", alimentos_fcast, alimentos),
    energia = if_else(sample == "ipom", energia_fcast, energiav12),
    
    ffr          = if_else(sample == "ipom", ffr_fcast, ffr),
    us10y        = if_else(sample == "ipom", us10y_fcast, us10y),
    vix          = if_else(sample == "ipom", vix_fcast, vix),
    tasa_neutral = if_else(sample == "ipom", tasa_neutral_fcast, tasa_neutral),
    tasa_coloc = if_else(sample == "ipom", tasa_coloc_fcast, tasa_coloc),
   tpm          = if_else(sample == "ipom", tpm_fcast, tpm),

    crec_socios  = if_else(sample == "ipom", crec_socios_fcast, crec_socios),
    eee_ipc12    = if_else(sample == "ipom", eee_ipc12_fcast, eee_ipc12),
       eee_ipcsv12    = if_else(sample == "ipom", eee_ipcsv12_fcast, eee_ipcsv12)

  )

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 13B.8 Extender CPI US para poder convivir con precios reales
## ----------------------------------------------------------
last_hist_cpi_idx <- max(which(!is.na(db_model$cpi_us) & db_model$qdate < q_start_fcast))
g_us_annual  <- 0.02
g_us_quarter <- (1 + g_us_annual)^(1/4) - 1

if (last_hist_cpi_idx < nrow(db_model)) {
  for (i in (last_hist_cpi_idx + 1):nrow(db_model)) {
    if (is.na(db_model$cpi_us[i])) {
      db_model$cpi_us[i] <- db_model$cpi_us[i - 1] * (1 + g_us_quarter)
    }
  }
}

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 13B.9 Reconstruir L_CPI y L_CPIXFE desde yoy
## ----------------------------------------------------------
db_model <- db_model %>%
  mutate(
    lipc         = if_else(sample == "ipom", NA_real_, lipc),
    lipc_sin_vol = if_else(sample == "ipom", NA_real_, lipc_sin_vol)
  )

db_model$lipc         <- fill_log_from_yoy(db_model$lipc,         db_model$cpi_yoy_fcast,    db_model$qdate)
db_model$lipc_sin_vol <- fill_log_from_yoy(db_model$lipc_sin_vol, db_model$cpixfe_yoy_fcast, db_model$qdate)

db_model <- db_model %>%
  mutate(
    ipc         = exp(lipc / 100),
    ipc_sin_vol = exp(lipc_sin_vol / 100)
  )

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 13B.10 Reconstruir L_GDP y L_GDP_BAR desde yoy + gap objetivo
## ----------------------------------------------------------
db_model <- db_model %>%
  mutate(
    lpib_no_minero = if_else(sample == "ipom", NA_real_, lpib_no_minero)
  )

for (i in seq_along(db_model$qdate)) {
  if (!is.na(db_model$gdp_yoy_fcast[i]) && db_model$qdate[i] >= q_start_fcast) {
    prev_qdate <- db_model$qdate[i] - 1
    j_prev <- which(db_model$qdate == prev_qdate)

    if (length(j_prev) == 1 && !is.na(db_model$lpib_no_minero[j_prev])) {
      d4_log <- 100 * log(1 + db_model$gdp_yoy_fcast[i] / 100)
      db_model$lpib_no_minero[i] <- db_model$lpib_no_minero[j_prev] + d4_log
    }
  }
}

db_model <- db_model %>%
  mutate(
    pib_no_minero = exp(lpib_no_minero / 100),
    gap_pib_bcch  = if_else(sample == "ipom", gap_pib_tgt_fcast, gap_pib_bcch),
    pib_pot_bcch  = if_else(sample == "ipom", lpib_no_minero - gap_pib_bcch, pib_pot_bcch)
  )

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 13B.11 Variables del modelo sobre muestra aumentada
## ----------------------------------------------------------
ss_TPMN1 <- 4.0
ss_L_Z   <- 100 * log(100)
ss_CRECSC <- 3.0
ss_T_COLOC <- 4.0
ss_FFR   <- 3.5
ss_VIX   <- 17
ss_UST10 <- 4.0
ss_L_PCU <- 100 * log(3.4)
ss_L_WTI <- 100 * log(59)

db_model <- db_model %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  mutate(
    GAP       = gap_pib_bcch,
    GAP_lag1  = dplyr::lag(GAP, 1),

    TPM       = tpm,
    TPM_lag1  = dplyr::lag(TPM, 1),
    TPMN1     = tasa_neutral,

    TPM_dev   = tpm - ss_TPMN1,
    TPM_dev_N = tpm - tasa_neutral,

    CRECSC    = crec_socios,
    FFR       = ffr,
    VIX       = vix,
    UST10     = us10y,

    L_PCU     = lcobre_real,
    L_WTI     = lpetroleo_real,
    T_COLOC   = tasa_coloc,
    
    Log_Food= log(alimentos),
    L_Food= 100*(Log_Food - lag(Log_Food, 4)),
    CRECSC_dev = CRECSC - ss_CRECSC,
    FFR_dev    = FFR - ss_FFR,
    VIX_dev    = VIX - ss_VIX,
    UST10_dev  = UST10 - ss_UST10,
    L_PCU_dev  = L_PCU - ss_L_PCU,
    L_WTI_dev  = L_WTI - ss_L_WTI,
    T_COLOC_dev = T_COLOC - ss_T_COLOC,
    L_Z_dev    = ltcr - ss_L_Z,

    dummy_19Q4 = if_else(year == 2019 & quarter == 4, 1, 0),
    dummy_20Q2 = if_else(year == 2020 & quarter == 2, 1, 0),
    dummy_20Q4 = if_else(year == 2020 & quarter == 4, 1, 0),
    dummy_08Q3 = if_else(year == 2008 & quarter == 3, 1, 0),
    dummy_98Q3 = if_else(year == 1998 & quarter == 3, 1, 0),
    dummy_2008Q1_2008Q4 = if_else(year == 2008 & quarter >= 1 & quarter <= 4, 1, 0),

    DLA_CPIXFE      = 4 * (lipc_sin_vol - dplyr::lag(lipc_sin_vol, 1)),
    DLA_CPIXFE_lag1 = dplyr::lag(DLA_CPIXFE, 1),

    D4L_CPI      = lipc - dplyr::lag(lipc, 4),
    D1L_CPI      = lipc - dplyr::lag(lipc, 1),
    DLA_CPI      = 4*(lipc - dplyr::lag(lipc, 1)),
    lead_D4L_CPI = dplyr::lead(D4L_CPI, 1),
    lead_D4_4L_CPI = dplyr::lead(D4L_CPI, 4),
    lead_D1L_CPI = dplyr::lead(D1L_CPI, 1),
    lag_D4L_CPI  = dplyr::lag(D4L_CPI, 1),
    lag_D4L_CPI_4 = dplyr::lag(D4L_CPI, 4),

    L_GDP_GAP      = gap_pib_bcch,
    L_GDP_GAP_lag1 = dplyr::lag(L_GDP_GAP, 1),

    Trimestre = factor(quarter),
    dummy_2021Q4_2023Q1 = if_else(
      (year == 2021 & quarter == 4) |
        (year == 2022) |
        (year == 2023 & quarter == 1),
      1, 0
    )
  )

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## Tendencia one-sided del ltcr en la muestra aumentada
## ----------------------------------------------------------
db_model$hp_ltcr <- hp_onesided(db_model$ltcr, lambda = 1600, min_obs = 20)

db_model <- db_model %>%
  mutate(
    L_Z_GAP     = ltcr - ss_L_Z,
    lag_L_Z_GAP = dplyr::lag(L_Z_GAP, 1),

    L_Z_GAP_Hp     = ltcr - hp_ltcr,
    lag_L_Z_GAP_Hp = dplyr::lag(L_Z_GAP_Hp, 1),

    DLA_CPIRES      = D1L_CPI - DLA_CPIXFE,
    DLA_CPIRES_lag1 = dplyr::lag(DLA_CPIRES, 1)
  )
aux_wti <- lm(L_WTI_dev ~ CRECSC_dev + FFR_dev + VIX_dev + UST10_dev + L_PCU_dev, data = db_model)
db_model$WTI_puro <- resid(aux_wti)


datos_IS_directo <- db_model %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  mutate(
    GAP_lag1_calc = dplyr::lag(GAP, 1),
    VIX_dev_lag1  = dplyr::lag(VIX_dev, 1),
    T_COLOC_dev   = T_COLOC - 4
  ) %>%
  select(
    qdate,
    GAP,
    GAP_lag1_calc,
    TPM_dev,
    CRECSC_dev,
    FFR_dev,
    VIX_dev_lag1,
    UST10_dev,
    L_PCU_dev,
    L_WTI_dev,
    L_Z_GAP,
    T_COLOC_dev,
    dummy_19Q4,
    dummy_20Q2,
    dummy_20Q4,
    dummy_08Q3,
    dummy_2008Q1_2008Q4,
    w,
    sample
  ) %>%
  na.omit()

modelo_IS_directo <- lm(
  GAP ~ 0 +
    GAP_lag1_calc +
    TPM_dev +
    T_COLOC_dev +
    CRECSC_dev +
    FFR_dev +
    UST10_dev +
    VIX_dev_lag1 +
    L_PCU_dev +
    L_WTI_dev +
    L_Z_GAP +
    dummy_19Q4 +
    dummy_20Q2 +
    dummy_20Q4,
  data = datos_IS_directo
)

summary(modelo_IS_directo)
b <- coef(modelo_IS_directo)

datos_IS_mci_estimado <- datos_IS_directo %>%
  mutate(
    contrib_TPM    = b["TPM_dev"]      * TPM_dev,
    contrib_TCOLOC = b["T_COLOC_dev"]  * T_COLOC_dev,
    contrib_FFR    = b["FFR_dev"]      * FFR_dev,
    contrib_UST10  = b["UST10_dev"]    * UST10_dev,
    contrib_VIX    = b["VIX_dev_lag1"] * VIX_dev_lag1,

    # Contribución total de condiciones financieras/cambiarias sobre el GAP
    contrib_MCI_expandido =
      contrib_TPM +
      contrib_TCOLOC +
      contrib_FFR +
      contrib_UST10 +
      contrib_VIX,

    # Definimos MCI de forma que MCI alto = más restrictivo.
    # Por eso le cambiamos el signo a la contribución expansiva.
    MCI_estimado = -contrib_MCI_expandido
  )
modelo_IS_mci_estimado <- lm(
  GAP ~ 0 +
    GAP_lag1_calc +
    lag(TPM_dev,4)+
     L_PCU_dev  +
    lag(L_WTI_dev)    ,
  data = datos_IS_mci_estimado
)

summary(modelo_IS_mci_estimado)


## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 14B. Estimación IS ponderada (historia + pseudo-IPoM)
## ----------------------------------------------------------
datos_IS_aug <- db_model %>%
  select(
    GAP, GAP_lag1, TPM, TPM_dev_N, TPM_dev, CRECSC_dev, FFR_dev, VIX_dev, UST10_dev,
    L_Z_GAP_Hp, L_Z_GAP, L_PCU_dev, L_WTI_dev, T_COLOC, WTI_puro,
    dummy_19Q4, dummy_20Q2, dummy_20Q4, dummy_08Q3, dummy_2008Q1_2008Q4,
    w, sample, qdate
  ) 

modelo_IS_aug <- lm(
  GAP ~ 0 + GAP_lag1 + lag(TPM_dev_N) + CRECSC_dev +FFR_dev+T_COLOC
     + UST10_dev + lag(L_PCU_dev) + lag(L_WTI_dev,3)+ L_WTI_dev  +
    dummy_19Q4 + dummy_20Q2 + dummy_20Q4 + L_Z_GAP + lag(VIX_dev,1),
  data = datos_IS_aug
)

summary(modelo_IS_aug)



bloque_fci <- db_model %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  select(FFR_dev, VIX_dev, UST10_dev)

idx_fci <- complete.cases(bloque_fci)

pca_fci <- prcomp(bloque_fci[idx_fci, ], scale. = TRUE)

db_model$FCI_global <- NA_real_
db_model$FCI_global[idx_fci] <- pca_fci$x[, 1]

## Normalizar signo:
## queremos que un FCI más alto = condiciones más restrictivas
if (cor(db_model$FCI_global[idx_fci],
        db_model$VIX_dev[idx_fci],
        use = "complete.obs") < 0) {
  db_model$FCI_global <- -db_model$FCI_global
}

## ==========================================================
## 2. Construir base IS con las variables necesarias
## ==========================================================

db_is <- db_model %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  mutate(
    GAP_lag1 = lag(GAP, 1),
    GAP_lag2 = lag(GAP, 2),

    ## brecha de tasa real ex-ante
    RPGAP = (TPM ),
    RPGAP_lag1 = lag(RPGAP, 1),

    ## spread crediticio local
    CRED = T_COLOC - TPM,
    CRED_lag1 = lag(CRED, 1),

    ## demanda externa rezagada
    CRECSC_dev_lag1 = lag(CRECSC_dev, 1),

    ## factor financiero global rezagado
    FCI_global_lag1 = lag(FCI_global, 1),

    ## cobre en cambio trimestral anualizado
    dL_PCU = 4 * (L_PCU - lag(L_PCU, 1)),
    dL_PCU_lag1 = lag(dL_PCU, 1),
    dL_WTI = 4 * (L_WTI - lag(L_WTI, 1)),
    dL_WTI_lag1 = lag(dL_WTI, 1),
    
    
    ## gap de TCR one-sided rezagado
    ## uso tu variable ya construida con HP one-sided
    L_Z_GAP_os_lag1 = lag(L_Z_GAP_Hp, 1),

    dummy_19Q4 = if_else(year == 2019 & quarter == 4, 1, 0),
    dummy_20Q2 = if_else(year == 2020 & quarter == 2, 1, 0),
    dummy_20Q3 = if_else(year == 2020 & quarter == 3, 1, 0)
  )

aux_pcu <- lm(dL_PCU ~ CRECSC_dev + FFR_dev + VIX_dev + UST10_dev, data = db_is)
db_is$PCU_puro <- NA_real_
db_is$PCU_puro[as.numeric(rownames(model.frame(aux_pcu)))] <- resid(aux_pcu)
db_is$PCU_puro_lag1 <- lag(db_is$PCU_puro, 1)

    aux_wti <- lm(dL_WTI ~  CRECSC_dev + FFR_dev + VIX_dev + UST10_dev, data = db_is)
db_is$WTI_puro <- NA_real_
db_is$WTI_puro[as.numeric(rownames(model.frame(aux_wti)))] <- resid(aux_wti)
db_is$WTI_puro_lag1 <- lag(db_is$WTI_puro, 3) * db_is$FCI_global_lag1
## ==========================================================
## 3. Estimar curva IS
## ==========================================================

datos_IS <- db_is %>%
  select(qdate,
    GAP, GAP_lag1, GAP_lag2, TPM, TPM_dev, RPGAP, RPGAP_lag1, CRED_lag1, PCU_puro, PCU_puro_lag1,WTI_puro, WTI_puro_lag1, T_COLOC_dev, Trimestre, 
    CRECSC_dev_lag1, CRECSC_dev, FCI_global_lag1, dL_PCU_lag1, dL_WTI_lag1,  FFR_dev, VIX_dev, UST10_dev, L_PCU_dev, L_WTI_dev, L_Z_GAP_Hp,
    L_Z_GAP_os_lag1, dummy_19Q4, dummy_20Q2, dummy_20Q3
  ) %>% filter(qdate >= as.yearqtr("2018 Q1"))

contrasts(datos_IS$Trimestre) <- contr.sum(4)

modelo_IS_aug <- lm(
  GAP ~ 0 + GAP_lag1 +  lag(TPM_dev, 1)+  lag(TPM_dev, 4) + (CRECSC_dev) +L_PCU_dev+ lag(L_WTI_dev) +  lag(FFR_dev) +  lag(VIX_dev) + UST10_dev +L_Z_GAP_Hp ,
  data = datos_IS
)

summary(modelo_IS_aug)



## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 15B. Phillips ponderada con restricción beta_lag + beta_exp = 1
##      Reparametrización:
##      y - exp = a + b*(lag-exp) + ...
## ----------------------------------------------------------
datos_IPC_aug <- db_model %>%
  mutate(
    y_ph  = DLA_CPIXFE - eee_ipcsv12,
    x_ph  = DLA_CPIXFE_lag1 - eee_ipcsv12
  )%>%
  select(
     L_GDP_GAP_lag1, L_GDP_GAP, L_Z_GAP_Hp, L_Food, Trimestre, DLA_CPIXFE, eee_ipc12 , DLA_CPI,
    dummy_2021Q4_2023Q1, w, sample, qdate
  )

contrasts(datos_IPC_aug$Trimestre) <- contr.sum(4)

modelo_IPC_aug <- lm(
  DLA_CPIXFE ~ lag(DLA_CPIXFE)  +lag(DLA_CPIXFE,4)  + eee_ipc12 + L_Z_GAP_Hp+  lag(L_GDP_GAP) +lag(L_Food)  + Trimestre + dummy_2021Q4_2023Q1,
  data = datos_IPC_aug
)

summary(modelo_IPC_aug)

beta_lag_ipc <- coef(modelo_IPC_aug)[["lag(DLA_CPIXFE)"]]
beta_exp_ipc <- 1 - beta_lag_ipc

cat("\n--- Phillips reparametrizada ---\n")
cat("beta_lag =", round(beta_lag_ipc, 6), "\n")
cat("beta_exp =", round(beta_exp_ipc, 6), "\n")

library(dplyr)
library(zoo)
library(systemfit)

datos_IPC_iv <- db_model %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  mutate(
    DLA_CPIXFE_lead1 = dplyr::lead(DLA_CPIXFE, 1),
     DLA_CPIXFE_lead4 = dplyr::lead(DLA_CPIXFE, 4),
     DLA_CPI_lag1 = dplyr::lag(DLA_CPI, 1),
      DLA_CPI_lead1 = dplyr::lead(DLA_CPI, 1),
    DLA_CPIXFE_lag4 = dplyr::lag(DLA_CPIXFE, 4),
    L_Food_lag1     = dplyr::lag(L_Food, 1),
    L_Z_GAP_Hp_lag1 = dplyr::lag(L_Z_GAP_Hp, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(
    qdate,
    DLA_CPI,
    DLA_CPI_lag1,
    DLA_CPIXFE,
    DLA_CPIXFE_lag1,
    DLA_CPIXFE_lag4,
    DLA_CPIXFE_lead1,
    DLA_CPIXFE_lead4,
    eee_ipc12,
    L_GDP_GAP,
    L_GDP_GAP_lag1,
    L_Z_GAP_Hp,
    L_Z_GAP_Hp_lag1,
    Trimestre,
    L_Food,
    L_Food_lag1,
    dummy_2021Q4_2023Q1
  ) 

eq_IPC_iv <- DLA_CPIXFE ~ 0+DLA_CPIXFE_lag1 + DLA_CPIXFE_lag4  + DLA_CPIXFE_lead1  + L_GDP_GAP + lag(L_Z_GAP_Hp) + lag(L_Food) + Trimestre  + dummy_2021Q4_2023Q1 

sistema_IPC_iv <- list(eq1 = eq_IPC_iv)

instrumentos_IPC <- ~ DLA_CPIXFE_lag1 + DLA_CPIXFE_lag4 + DLA_CPI_lag1 + eee_ipc12 + lag(eee_ipc12) +L_GDP_GAP + lag(L_GDP_GAP) + lag(L_Z_GAP_Hp) + lag(L_Food) + Trimestre + dummy_2021Q4_2023Q1 

restriction_IPC_iv <- c(
  " eq1_DLA_CPIXFE_lag1 +  eq1_DLA_CPIXFE_lag4 +  eq1_DLA_CPIXFE_lead1 = 1"
)

modelo_iv_restringido_IPC <- systemfit(
  sistema_IPC_iv,
  data = datos_IPC_iv,
  method = "2SLS",
  inst = instrumentos_IPC,
  restrict.matrix = restriction_IPC_iv
)

summary(modelo_iv_restringido_IPC)

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 15C. IPC no core ponderada
## ----------------------------------------------------------
datos_IPCnoCore_aug <- db_model %>%
  select(
    D1L_CPI, DLA_CPIXFE, DLA_CPIRES_lag1, cpi_us, lag_L_Z_GAP, L_Z_GAP_Hp, L_Z_GAP, L_Food, CRECSC_dev,
    lpetroleo_real, lcobre_real, cobre,L_PCU_dev, L_WTI_dev, petroleo, GAP,Trimestre,
    w, sample,dummy_2021Q4_2023Q1, qdate
  ) %>%
  mutate(desvL_WTI= (lpetroleo_real-lag(lpetroleo_real,1)),
        DLA4_CPI  = (4*D1L_CPI),
    DLA_CPIRES  = DLA4_CPI-DLA_CPIXFE,
  )  %>%   filter(qdate >= as.yearqtr("2020 Q1"))

contrasts(datos_IPCnoCore_aug$Trimestre) <- contr.sum(4)

reg_cpires_aug <- lm(
  DLA_CPIRES ~ lag(DLA_CPIRES,1) +lag(DLA_CPIRES,4) + CRECSC_dev+ L_Z_GAP_Hp + lag(L_Food)+
    lag(desvL_WTI) + lag(L_WTI_dev,4)+ Trimestre + dummy_2021Q4_2023Q1,
  data = datos_IPCnoCore_aug
)

summary(reg_cpires_aug)

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 16B. Taylor con restricción beta_lag + beta_neutral = 1
##      Reparametrización:
##      TPM - TPMN1 = b*(TPM_lag1 - TPMN1) + ...
##
## OJO: si no pones senda futura de TPM, la parte IPoM no entra
## en esta ecuación y Taylor queda esencialmente histórica.
## ----------------------------------------------------------
datos_Taylor_aug <- db_model %>%
  mutate(
    y_tay = TPM - TPMN1,
    x_tay = TPM_lag1 - TPMN1
  ) %>%
  select(
    TPM, TPMN1, y_tay, x_tay, lead_D4L_CPI, lead_D4_4L_CPI, L_GDP_GAP,GAP_lag1, DLA_CPIXFE,
    eee_ipc12, lag_D4L_CPI_4, lag_D4L_CPI,
    w, sample, qdate, dummy_2021Q4_2023Q1
  ) %>% filter(qdate >= as.yearqtr("2010 Q1"))


modelo_Taylor_aug <- AER::ivreg(
  TPM ~ x_tay + lead_D4L_CPI + L_GDP_GAP |
    x_tay  + lag(eee_ipc12,4)+ eee_ipc12+ L_GDP_GAP  + lag(DLA_CPIXFE)+ lag_D4L_CPI, 
  data = datos_Taylor_aug
)

summary(modelo_Taylor_aug)

beta_lag_taylor     <- coef(modelo_Taylor_aug)[["x_tay"]]
beta_neutral_taylor <- 1 - beta_lag_taylor

cat("\n--- Taylor reparametrizada ---\n")
cat("beta_lag_TPM =", round(beta_lag_taylor, 6), "\n")
cat("beta_TPMN1   =", round(beta_neutral_taylor, 6), "\n")


## ==========================================================
## 16. Regla de Taylor (2SLS con restricción) - estilo original
##    pero usando db_model
## ==========================================================

library(systemfit)

datos_Taylor <- db_model %>%
  select(qdate,
    TPM, TPM_lag1, TPMN1,
    lead_D4L_CPI, lead_D1L_CPI,
    L_GDP_GAP, lag_L_Z_GAP,
    D4L_CPI, eee_ipc12,
    lag_D4L_CPI, lag_D4L_CPI_4, dummy_2021Q4_2023Q1
  ) %>% filter(qdate >= as.yearqtr("2005 Q1"))

eq_Taylor <- TPM ~ TPM_lag1 + TPMN1 +
  lead_D4L_CPI + L_GDP_GAP + dummy_2021Q4_2023Q1

sistema_Taylor <- list(eq1 = eq_Taylor)

# Restricción: coef_TPM_lag1 + coef_TPMN1 = 1
restriction_Taylor <- c("eq1_TPM_lag1 + eq1_TPMN1 = 1")

# Instrumentos para 2SLS
instrumentos_Taylor <- ~ TPM_lag1 +TPMN1  + lag(eee_ipc12,1) + lag(eee_ipc12,4)+ L_GDP_GAP+ lag(L_GDP_GAP) +
  lag_D4L_CPI + D4L_CPI + dummy_2021Q4_2023Q1

modelo_restringido_Taylor <- systemfit(

library(dplyr)

 petroleo_nom = c(82.5, 88.6, 87.5, 85.6, 78.0, 75.2,73.3, 72.4, 71.9),

db_all <- db_trimestral %>%

  ) %>%

## ---- 18.4 Helper: de % a/a -> log(nivel)*100 ---------------
fill_log_from_yoy <- function(log_var, yoy_perc, qdate_vec) {
  out <- log_var
  for (i in seq_along(out)) {
    if (is.na(out[i]) && !is.na(yoy_perc[i])) {
      prev_qdate <- qdate_vec[i] - 1
      j <- which(qdate_vec == prev_qdate)
      if (length(j) == 1 && !is.na(out[j])) {
        # INTERPRETAMOS yoy_perc COMO D4L DIRECTO
        d4_log <- yoy_perc[i]          # NO log(1 + yoy_perc/100)
        out[i] <- out[j] + d4_log
      }
    }
  }
  out
}

db_all <- db_all %>%
  mutate(
    lipc         = if_else(qdate >= q_start_fcast, NA_real_, lipc),
    lipc_sin_vol = if_else(qdate >= q_start_fcast, NA_real_, lipc_sin_vol)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    lipc         = fill_log_from_yoy(lipc,         cpi_yoy,    qdate),
    lipc_sin_vol = fill_log_from_yoy(lipc_sin_vol, cpixfe_yoy, qdate)
  )




## ---- 18.5 PIB real y potencial a partir de gdp_yoy y gap --- 
## Aquí sí respondemos a tus 2 condiciones:
## 1) L_GDP respeta tu crecimiento anual proyectado
## 2) L_GDP_BAR se calcula para que el gap = gap_pib_tgt

# 18.5.1 Construir L_GDP (lpib_no_minero) para q >= q_start_fcast
for (i in seq_along(db_all$qdate)) {
  if (!is.na(db_all$gdp_yoy[i]) && db_all$qdate[i] >= q_start_fcast) {
    prev_qdate <- db_all$qdate[i] - 1        # t-4 (un año atrás)
    j_prev <- which(db_all$qdate == prev_qdate)
    if (length(j_prev) == 1 && !is.na(db_all$lpib_no_minero[j_prev])) {
      d4_log <- 100 * log(1 + db_all$gdp_yoy[i] / 100)
      db_all$lpib_no_minero[i] <- db_all$lpib_no_minero[j_prev] + d4_log
    } else {
      warning(paste(
        "No se pudo calcular L_GDP para", as.character(db_all$qdate[i]),
        "por falta de dato en t-4."
      ))
    }
  }
}

# 18.5.2 Construir PIB potencial como residual: L_GDP_BAR = L_GDP - gap_tgt
db_all <- db_all %>%
  mutate(
    pib_pot_bcch = if_else(
      !is.na(gap_pib_tgt) & !is.na(lpib_no_minero) & qdate >= q_start_fcast,
      lpib_no_minero - gap_pib_tgt,
      pib_pot_bcch   # se mantiene el histórico tal cual
    )
  )

## ---- 18.6 L_PCU y L_WTI en precios REALES (deflactados por CPI US) ----

# 1) Extender CPI US hacia adelante con una hipótesis de inflación anual
#    (aquí supongo 2% anual a partir del último dato observado)

last_cpi_idx <- max(which(!is.na(db_all$cpi_us)))
g_us_annual  <- 0.02                          # 2% anual -> cambia esto si quieres otra hipótesis
g_us_quarter <- (1 + g_us_annual)^(1/4) - 1   # crecimiento trimestral constante

if (last_cpi_idx < nrow(db_all)) {
  for (i in (last_cpi_idx + 1):nrow(db_all)) {
    db_all$cpi_us[i] <- db_all$cpi_us[i - 1] * (1 + g_us_quarter)
  }
}

# 2) Elegir precio nominal "a usar": histórico (cobre, petroleo) o proyección (cobre_nom, petroleo_nom)

db_all <- db_all %>%
  mutate(
    cobre_nom_use    = if_else(!is.na(cobre_nom),    cobre_nom,    cobre),
    petroleo_nom_use = if_else(!is.na(petroleo_nom), petroleo_nom, petroleo)
  )

# 3) Deflactar a dólares de 2020Q1 usando el mismo cpi_us_ref de la sección 10
#    cobre_real_t = cobre_nom_t * (cpi_us_ref / cpi_us_t)

db_all <- db_all %>%
  mutate(
    cobre_real_all = if_else(
      !is.na(cobre_nom_use) & !is.na(cpi_us) & cobre_nom_use > 0 & cpi_us > 0,
      cobre_nom_use * cpi_us_ref / cpi_us,
      NA_real_
    ),
    petroleo_real_all = if_else(
      !is.na(petroleo_nom_use) & !is.na(cpi_us) & petroleo_nom_use > 0 & cpi_us > 0,
      petroleo_nom_use * cpi_us_ref / cpi_us,
      NA_real_
    ),
    
    # 4) Logaritmo natural de los precios reales * 100
    L_PCU = if_else(
      !is.na(cobre_real_all) & cobre_real_all > 0,
      log(cobre_real_all) * 100,
      NA_real_
    ),
    L_WTI = if_else(
      !is.na(petroleo_real_all) & petroleo_real_all > 0,
      log(petroleo_real_all) * 100,
      NA_real_
    )
  )


db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  mutate(
    # Nominales en log*100
    L_PCU_NOM = if_else(!is.na(cobre) & cobre > 0,
                        log(cobre) * 100, NA_real_),
    L_WTI_NOM = if_else(!is.na(petroleo) & petroleo > 0,
                        log(petroleo) * 100, NA_real_),

    # CPI US en log*100
    L_CPI_US = if_else(!is.na(cpi_us) & cpi_us > 0,
                       log(cpi_us) * 100, NA_real_),

    # Inflación US
    D4L_CPI_US = L_CPI_US - dplyr::lag(L_CPI_US, 4),
    DLA_CPI_US = 4 * (L_CPI_US - dplyr::lag(L_CPI_US, 1))
  )
cpi_us_ref_2020q1 <- db_trimestral %>%
  filter(qdate == as.yearqtr("2020 Q1")) %>%

db_trimestral <- db_trimestral %>%

                            100 * cpi_us / cpi_us_ref_2020q1,
                            NA_real_)
  )

## ==========================================================
## 19. Generar vectores Matlab listos para IRIS
## ==========================================================

make_matlab_vec <- function(db, var, name, q_from, q_to, digits = 12) {
  sub <- db %>%
    filter(qdate >= q_from, qdate <= q_to) %>%
    arrange(qdate)
  vals <- sub[[var]]
  if (any(is.na(vals))) {
    warning(paste("La variable", var, "tiene NA en el rango de proyección."))
  }
  txt <- paste0(
    name, "(startfcast:startfcast+", length(vals) - 1, ") = [",
    paste0(round(vals, digits), collapse = ", "),
    "];"
  )
  cat(txt, "\n")
}

## ==========================================================
## 20. Exportar Data.csv para IRIS desde db_model
## ==========================================================

library(dplyr)
library(zoo)
library(lubridate)

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 20.1. Elegir si el CSV incluye o no la pseudo-muestra IPoM
## ----------------------------------------------------------
include_ipom_in_history <- TRUE

start_q <- as.yearqtr("2000 Q1")
end_q   <- if (include_ipom_in_history) tail(q_fcast, 1) else as.yearqtr("2025 Q4")

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 20.2. Construir extras nominales / USA sobre db_model
## ----------------------------------------------------------
cpi_us_ref_2020q1_model <- db_model %>%
  filter(qdate == as.yearqtr("2020 Q1")) %>%
  pull(cpi_us)

db_export_iris <- db_model %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  mutate(
    quarter_num = quarter(as.Date(qdate)),

    ## Variables nominales en log*100
    L_PCU_NOM = if_else(!is.na(cobre) & cobre > 0,
                        log(cobre) * 100, NA_real_),
    L_WTI_NOM = if_else(!is.na(petroleo) & petroleo > 0,
                        log(petroleo) * 100, NA_real_),

    ## CPI US
    CPI_US_2020 = if_else(!is.na(cpi_us) & !is.na(cpi_us_ref_2020q1_model),
                          100 * cpi_us / cpi_us_ref_2020q1_model,
                          NA_real_),
    L_CPI_US = if_else(!is.na(cpi_us) & cpi_us > 0,
                       log(cpi_us) * 100, NA_real_),
    D4L_CPI_US = L_CPI_US - dplyr::lag(L_CPI_US, 4),
    DLA_CPI_US = 4 * (L_CPI_US - dplyr::lag(L_CPI_US, 1)),

    ## Gap cambiario consistente con tu calibración actual
    L_Z_GAP = ltcr - ss_L_Z
  )

## ----------------------------------------------------------
## 20.3. Exportar el rango que quieras a Data.csv
## ----------------------------------------------------------
history_iris <- db_export_iris %>%
  filter(qdate >= start_q, qdate <= end_q) %>%
  arrange(qdate) %>%
  transmute(
    period    = format(qdate, "%YQ%q"),

    ## Variables del modelo
    L_GDP     = lpib_no_minero,
    L_GDP_BAR = pib_pot_bcch,
    L_GDP_GAP = gap_pib_bcch,
    L_CPI     = lipc,
    L_CPIXFE  = lipc_sin_vol,
    TPM       = tpm,
    TPMN1     = tasa_neutral,
    T_COLOC   = tasa_coloc,
    L_Z       = ltcr,
    CRECSC    = crec_socios,
    L_PCU     = lcobre_real,
    L_WTI     = lpetroleo_real,
    FFR       = ffr,
    UST10     = us10y,
    VIX       = vix,

    ## Dummies trimestrales
    Q1        = as.integer(quarter_num == 1),
    Q2        = as.integer(quarter_num == 2),
    Q3        = as.integer(quarter_num == 3),
    Q4        = as.integer(quarter_num == 4),

    ## Extra útil
    L_Z_GAP   = L_Z_GAP,

    L_Food   = L_Food,

    ## Extras nominales / USA
    PCU_NOM    = cobre,
    WTI_NOM    = petroleo,
    L_PCU_NOM  = L_PCU_NOM,
    L_WTI_NOM  = L_WTI_NOM,
    CPI_US     = cpi_us,
    CPI_US_2020 = CPI_US_2020,
    L_CPI_US   = L_CPI_US,
    D4L_CPI_US = D4L_CPI_US,
    DLA_CPI_US = DLA_CPI_US
  )

## Dejar primera columna sin nombre, como antes
history_iris <- as.data.frame(history_iris)
names(history_iris)[1] <- ""

## Guardar CSV
write.csv(
  history_iris,
  file = file.path("..", "..", "data", "raw", "Data.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
